name: aangan-studio
description: AI voice front desk for Aangan Studio (Pune): answers every enquiry call, qualifies it against the founder's 5 criteria with Gemini, books Cal.com consultations, hands off via Telegram and HubSpot. MESA Founder's Office case 03.

paragraphs: Every phone enquiry to Aangan Studio gets answered within seconds, day or night. A Vaani Labs voice agent runs the conversation, this app checks the caller against Nikhil's five criteria (studio/qualified.md), books qualified callers into a designer consultation (Cal.com), sends the designer a full handoff note (Telegram), and logs every call to HubSpot and Neon Postgres.
Scope: incoming phone calls only. See "Extending to WhatsApp and the web form" below. Built for the MESA Founder's Office case 03 (Nikhil Deshpande, Aangan Studio, Pune).
Live: dashboard at aangan-studio-two.vercel.app (open for review; see Dashboard for the password switch).
